title: Pad check
author: Iced-Cream
description: A test for core-ar2's ev_pad and LEDs on the Analog Rytm MKII, on screen. BD's strikes are taken (no sound, no note, no track select); RS's releases are answered 1 but stock keeps them, since it played the strike; after an odd number of BD strikes the BD pad and trig key 1 show the mod's colours, after an even number stock's again. A bottom bar shows each pad's strike, release and pressure counts, the current track, the last strike's flags and velocity, and the pads taken.
